description: Analyze (AI). AI Content API analyzes any webpage and returns AI insights summary, value proposition, features, categories, use cases, and optional contact signals. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

cache_ttl.description: Cache the response for a custom TTL (in seconds). Default: 2592000.

custom_prompt.description: Add your own instructions to guide the AI’s analysis.

custom_response.description: Pass custom response fields to be included in the AI response.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

proxy.description: Specify a proxy server to route your request through.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to capture.

name: analyze
title: Analyze (AI)
